cap: Three causes of urethritis and cervicitis are defined by their cell biology. Chlamydia lives inside cells as an infectious elementary body and a dividing reticulate body, and its wall has too little peptidoglycan for beta-lactams to work. The gonococcus is a diplococcus that does not ferment maltose; its changing pili explain reinfection, and missing C5 to C9 invites repeated Neisseria disease. Mycoplasma has no wall at all.
